s_foster.sees: Foster Hall seen across the entry drive: a cream Italianate mansion with a wrap-around ground-floor colonnade porch, bracketed eaves and a small central rooftop belvedere, set behind a lawn with a flagpole in front. A low monument sign sits in a flower bed at the drive.
s_foster.frontage: Open lawn, no fence; red-painted kerbs; stone-coloured monument sign about 1.2 m high and 6 m long in a bed of red and white flowers; flagpole about 10 m; parking lot at left.

s_thacher_field.sees: Nothing of the school is visible: the view is completely filled by a dense evergreen hedge along the sidewalk.
s_thacher_field.frontage: Solid broadleaf evergreen hedge about 4-5 m tall right at the back of the sidewalk, ivy ground cover at its foot.

s_leadership.sees: A long single-storey cream stucco wing with a low brown hip roof, tall dark-green multi-pane windows in a regular row and an arched entry porch at its left end. A concrete ramp/steps with low concrete walls leads to the arch; a service road with a utility cart runs past on the left.
s_leadership.frontage: Lawn strip with a clipped hedge about 1.2 m against the wall, low concrete walls (0.6 m) along the ramp, a campus map sign on posts about 1.2 m, black wall lanterns; red kerb.

s_library_pool.sees: Corner of a two-storey beige stucco building with large dark-green framed multi-pane windows on both floors and a projecting string course between them. To the left a white wall and a black vertical-bar gate about 2.4 m high close off a service yard.
s_library_pool.frontage: Planting bed with ornamental grasses and mulch between sidewalk and wall; black steel bar fence and gate 2.4 m; white rendered wall about 3 m at left; small red sign on posts.

s_pool_5th.sees: A long plain white wall about 3 m high screens the aquatic centre from Fifth Avenue, with small lettering 'AQUATIC CENTER' at left and faint 'MARIN ACADEMY' lettering at right. Behind at left is a two-storey cream building with green-framed windows and a low hip roof; a brick building (not school) is at the right.
s_pool_5th.frontage: White rendered wall 3 m high for about 40 m, entry ramp with steel handrails at left, black bar gates at both ends, planting bed with low shrubs and young trees, bike hoops at the kerb, tall light poles behind the wall.

s_pac_cottage.sees: Tall cream stucco performing-arts building: a windowless two-storey-high volume with horizontal metal reveal bands and a parapet at left, and a taller block at right with a deep overhanging dark metal eave and a double-height dark-green framed window. A ground-floor band of green-mullioned glazing faces the sidewalk.
s_pac_cottage.frontage: Mulched planting bed about 3 m deep with low shrubs and grasses, no fence; street tree in the sidewalk strip.

s_founders.sees: Oblique view along Fifth Avenue of the same large cream stucco block: mostly blank wall with horizontal bands, a recessed glazed entrance with a dark metal canopy near the middle. A board-formed concrete retaining wall carries the name in raised letters beside an accessible ramp with steel handrails.
s_founders.frontage: Concrete retaining wall rising from 0.5 to 1.5 m with a steel handrail on top, lettering on the wall near the entrance, planting strip with grasses and round shrubs, clipped hedge about 1.5 m further east, young street trees.

s_visual_arts.sees: Single-storey olive-tan stucco building with a flat roof and dark metal coping. A long band of dark-green framed windows with pale blinds under a standing-seam metal sunshade, and one smaller window with its own small metal canopy at right.
s_visual_arts.frontage: Continuous clipped hedge about 1.4 m high the full width, mulch strip and sidewalk in front, red fire hydrant; gravel strip at the kerb.

s_field_east.sees: View from above across the green synthetic-turf field with a red logo at centre circle. Beyond it stand a low two-storey white building with long window bands and a three-storey white block with horizontal dark window strips, plus brick-red terracing at the field edge.
s_field_east.frontage: Road sits above the field: weedy grass bank and shrubs, chain-link/netting fence about 3 m at the field edge below; red kerb.

s_gyms_north.sees: No school building is visible from here: the view shows a private cream two-level house (number 4244) with a tall red-brick chimney and garage, a lawn bank with concrete steps, and a large palm filling the right half.
s_gyms_north.frontage: Asphalt parking apron with painted bays, lawn bank with steps; no school fence or sign in view.

s_science.sees: Looking along the west side of the field: at left a three-storey cream stucco building with dark-green framed windows and a galvanised steel sunshade/trellis frame projecting from the upper floors and roof; beyond it a newer three-storey flat-roofed block in cream with grey panels. The green turf field with soccer goals is at right.
s_science.frontage: Black chain-link fence and double gates about 2.4 m across the field entrance, black steel bar fence 1.8 m on a concrete retaining wall at left, bark-mulch bank, small red sign on posts.

s_leadership_5th.sees: Two-storey beige stucco building in Mission style with a curved parapet gable over an arched upper opening, dark-green multi-pane windows, round wall medallions and a low-pitch roof with dark green fascia. A solid stucco-walled exterior stair rises diagonally across the front to the right; a white arched doorway sits at ground level.
